sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-17 and 2016-12-31, an unusual device profile identified as '? | ? | safari 10.0 | ?' was used to conduct transactions across multiple accounts, including card C12785-K2 held by C12785. On 2016-12-31, two online transactions (IDs 3588461 and 3588462) totaling $300.12 were processed within one minute. This device profile is shared with eight other cards, including C02247-K1, C03784-K1, and C04386-K1, suggesting coordinated unauthorized access. The transactions were flagged by the bank's risk model with scores of 0.73 and 0.70. Similar activity in closed cases CC-3986 and CC-5065 was confirmed as card-not-present fraud. The cardholder has a prior history of fraud (CC-5233), and the current activity lacks legitimate authorization. The rapid succession of transactions from a shared, unusual device is indicative of coordinated unauthorized use. The total exposure for this episode is $300.12. The bank has blocked card C12785-K2 and initiated monitoring on all connected cards. This report is filed due to the connection to a shared device profile and suspected coordinated abuse.
